COMMAND REFERENCE / 001

Before the silence.

Command the Western Alliance with classic v1.43 unit assets and movement parameters. Deploy a finite arsenal, launch aircraft from their hosts, and manage unit states through nuclear escalation.

01 / Deploy

During DEFCON 5–4, place your remaining ground units or compose a fleet of one to six ships. Finite inventories replace deployment credits.

02 / Command

Left click to select. Right click the map to move the fleet or aircraft. Right click a unit to change its state. Left click a target for the selected unit’s primary action.

03 / Release

At DEFCON 1, switch a silo, submarine or bomber to nuclear launch. Wait through preparation, then left click a target. Silos in launch mode cannot provide air defense.

04 / Survive

Aircraft consume fuel, return to a compatible host and land. Default scoring: +2 per million enemy dead, −1 per million allied dead. The 45-minute victory timer starts when nuclear inventory reaches 20%.

Carrier: 5 fighters, 2 bombers, 6 SRBMs; fighter, bomber or anti-submarine state. Airbase: 5 fighters, 5 bombers, 10 SRBMs. Silo: 10 ICBMs, defense or launch. Submarine: 5 MRBMs, passive, active or surfaced launch. Bomber: one SRBM, naval or nuclear state. Radar discovers contacts; submerged submarines require sonar.
